title: Sampling & Digital Representation
html:
AP Computer Science Principles

Sampling &
Representation

采样与数字表示

From changing signals to stored bits · 90 minutes
note: 由第一章的数据表示和简单程序接入第二章：计算机如何把真实世界中连续变化的信息保存下来？今天重点是“保留哪些信息、舍去哪些细节”。不要求音频工程、编码标准背诵或新程序控制结构。实验是图形化采样模型，不录音、不播放实际音频。

title: Retrieve bits, values and context
html:
1. How many patterns can 3 bits represent?
  2. After x ← 6 then x ← x + 2, what value does x hold?
  3. Does the bit pattern 0110 always mean the number 6?
Show answer
1. 8 patterns.
2. 8. Assignment stores the new value.
3. No. It means 6 under the stated unsigned integer interpretation; other encodings can assign another meaning.
note: 给90秒独立作答，再同桌解释两题。第一题为位数与模式，第二题为赋值顺序，第三题为本课文本、图像和声音铺垫。提醒“同一模式在不同语境含义不同”不等于可以在同一个已约定编码中随意解释。若学生把第二题视为代数等式，先说读取旧值6再保存8，不在此扩展代码。

title: Today’s explanation targets
html:
1. Distinguish analog and digital representations.
  2. Explain regular sampling and finite value precision.
  3. Compare sample frequency with available value levels.
  4. Use an encoding to interpret text, image and sound data.

关键问题：数字模型保留了什么？没有保留什么？
note: 最后让学生用两个独立维度解释数字近似：何时测量、允许存哪些值。文本与位图用于说明相同位模式如何被约定解释，像素容量计算是明确简化模型的应用，不把它说成每个实际图片文件的固定大小。

title: Analog and digital describe representations
html:
Analog · 模拟

A changing signal is modeled with smoothly varying values.

Example: air-pressure variation during a sound.

Digital · 数字

Stored values use discrete bit patterns.

Example: a sequence of encoded sound measurements.

Digitization builds a representation of the signal.
note: 用连续变化的声压举例，避免只凭设备是否带屏幕来判断模拟或数字。真实物理世界与测量模型不要混在一起；本课用平滑曲线表示模拟信号。数字存储选用离散代码，屏幕可以把点画成平滑线，但不会因此变成原始模拟数据。

title: Separate the signal from its record
html:
A greenhouse’s temperature changes throughout an hour.

  1. The continuously changing temperature is modeled by a smooth curve.
  2. A computer file stores one rounded temperature each minute.

Which representation is analog, and which is digital?

Show answer
1: analog model. Values vary continuously.
2: digital record. It stores discrete measurements at selected times.
note: 先让学生指出判断依据不是“温度是自然现象所以永远模拟”，而是现在讨论的表示。温度随时间变化与文件内的数字记录是两个层次。回答只给analog/digital不充分，需说明连续变化与离散记录。承认一个测量值可能已由传感器数字化；题目要求根据已给模型分类，不猜设备实现。

title: Sampling chooses when to measure
html:
Take a measurement at regular time intervals.

0 s   →   1 s   →   2 s   →   3 s

Sampling interval

The time between measurements.

Sampling rate

The number of measurements per unit time.

A shorter interval means a higher rate.
note: 在板书画横轴，仅标测量位置，不立即引入精度。0、1、2、3秒的例子说明固定间隔1秒；不要拿包含两个端点的四个点除以3秒来混淆频率定义。样本数与采样率的比较须固定记录持续时间；本课实验同一时间窗口中选择4/8/16个样本。暂不教奈奎斯特、频谱或抗混叠滤波。

title: Finite levels choose what value to store
html:
A toy sensor can store only 0, 3, 6 or 9 units.

It rounds each measurement to the nearest allowed level.

Measured valueStored value?
4.1?
7.8?
Show answer
4.1 → 3 and 7.8 → 9. The stored values approximate the measurements.
note: 学生先比较距离：4.1距3为1.1、距6为1.9；7.8距9为1.2、距6为1.8。本页没有中点相等，不需要另定平局规则。可把这种幅度值离散化叫quantization（量化）作为补充术语，但考查目标是有限精度导致近似，不要求背工程术语。这里是自定义传感器模型，不是通用音频格式。

title: Two independent controls
html:
More samples

More measurement times in the same duration.

Can reveal changes between widely spaced measurements.

More value levels

More possible stored values over the same range.

Can reduce rounding to coarse levels.

Changing one control does not automatically change the other.
note: 画两个箭头：横轴点更密与纵轴可选刻度更多。比较时明确同一持续时间、同一数值范围、其他条件不变。不要说采样更多一定让每一个具体测量的误差都更小；它主要改变测量时刻，值的精细程度由可用等级影响。也不保证增加等级后每个样本都严格更准，因为某些值原来已可精确表示。

title: Predict before changing the model
html:
Open Chapter 2 Data Lab → Sampling

  1. Start with 4 samples and 4 value levels.
  2. Keep the displayed signal and time window fixed.
  3. Predict what increasing only the sample count will change.
Show prediction check
You will measure at more times. The set of allowed value levels stays unchanged.

This is a visual model, not an audio recording.
note: 设备就绪后每两人一组，一人操作一人记录，下一轮交换。请先写预测，不允许“把两个滑块都调到最大再说更好”。若共享设备，教师投影、全班纸笔记录也可完成。实验显示4/8/16样本与4/8/16等级，图上的模型用于解释信息取舍，不能据此判断某段真实音频的听感质量。

title: Experiment A: change the sample count
html:
Keep 4 value levels. Try 4 → 8 → 16 samples.

  1. Record one change you can see in the measurements.
  2. Record one limitation that remains.
  3. Explain the storage tradeoff if bits per sample stay fixed.
Show the key comparison
More times are measured; the values still use only four levels. With fixed bits per sample, more samples require more payload bits.
note: 前2分钟依次操作记录，中间2分钟同伴交换解释，最后2分钟抽取证据。要求指出具体新测量位置，不只写“better”。样本数越多未必每个点都与旧点重合，不能要求新数据一定包含所有旧位置。只要固定每样本位数，N增加会按比例增加未压缩数据量。把原始线与样本点区别讲清，连线是可视化辅助。

title: Experiment B: change the value levels
html:
Keep 8 samples. Try 4 → 8 → 16 levels.

  1. Do the measurement times change?
  2. How does the set of possible stored values change?
  3. Which difference from the original signal can remain?
Show the key comparison
Times stay fixed. More levels allow finer value steps over the same range. Values between measurement times are still not directly recorded.
note: 交换操作员与记录员。区分可用levels与实际出现的levels：8个样本不会一定用到16种不同等级。相同幅度范围下更多均匀等级缩小级距，可减小可达到的最坏舍入误差；不要要求每个数值的误差严格下降。仍然存在测量之间遗漏的信息，增加等级不会增加测量次数。

title: A digital record leaves things out
html:
Two temperature curves can pass through the same recorded samples.

One curve rises briefly between samples. The other does not.

The stored samples alone may not reveal that difference.

Does “more samples” guarantee an exact copy of every possible signal?

Show answer
No. A finite record has limited measurement times and value precision. Greater detail can improve the approximation without guaranteeing exactness.
note: 画两个通过相同点的曲线，只在点间让一条出现小峰值，这是重要反例。不要把“采样模型遗漏信息”教成“任何数字数据都一定已经失真”：自定义文字编码可以无歧义地保存离散符号。本课讨论连续信号的有限近似。重建定理、带限信号的特殊假设不在本课范围，因此用every possible signal的限定避免过度绝对。

title: Bits determine the number of possible levels
html:
Bits per samplePossible value codes
2 bits4
3 bits8
4 bits16

Sixteen samples use 2 bits each. How many payload bits?

Show answer
16 × 2 = 32 bits. At 4 bits per sample: 16 × 4 = 64 bits.

Fixed-length sample codes; no headers, compression or extra channels.
note: 明确这里数levels用2的幂，数实际采样数据量用样本数乘每样本位数；不能混成16²。4级表示4种值，不等于每个值4位。没有保留码且使用所有位模式；复杂编码和声道不在本计算中。常见错误：16samples16levels就16×16bits，要求先把levels换成最少位数。

title: Text needs an agreed character code
html:
A custom classroom code:

Code00011011
CharacterABCspace

Decode 00 01 11 10.

Show answer
AB C. Group the stream into 2-bit codes and apply the supplied table.

This is a made-up code. Real text encodings need not use one byte per character.
note: 强调这张表是自定义课堂编码，不是ASCII或Unicode。发送接收双方要知道表和分组规则，才能恢复字符。表示空格时答案AB C中间留一空格，可口读“A、B、空格、C”。本页不教授UTF-8字节结构，也不把“所有英文字符1字节”“所有汉字2字节”当成普遍规则。

title: An image can be represented as pixels
html:
A simple bitmap records a grid of pixel values.

000110
111000

00 = white · 01 = light gray
10 = dark gray · 11 = black

This image is 3 pixels wide × 2 pixels high.

How many pixels and how many bits per pixel?

Show answer
6 pixels, using 2 bits per pixel in this specified encoding.
note: 学生先看grid的行列，再问白色像素要不要占码。答案需要：每个位置都有值，白色也占2位。采用灰度四级是简化调色板，pixel不固定等于一个字节。这里宽3高2，总6像素；不要把屏幕中每个大表格单元的物理屏幕像素算进去，它是单个数据像素的放大显示。

title: Calculate the uncompressed pixel payload
html:
A bitmap is 12 × 8 pixels, with 4 bits per pixel.

width × height × bits per pixel

Find the pixel payload in bits and bytes.

Show answer
12 × 8 = 96 pixels.
96 × 4 = 384 bits = 48 bytes.

Uncompressed, fixed-width pixel data only. Exclude metadata, headers, palettes and padding.
note: 要求写单位：先像素，后bits，最后除8得bytes。不用KB、KiB避免与本课目标无关的单位分歧。12×8的两个数是像素尺寸，不是英寸或每英寸像素。清楚写payload：该算式不预测PNG/JPEG实际文件大小，真实文件的头、调色板、填充、压缩会影响总大小。像素计算作为对位模式的课堂应用，不额外声称独立CED考点。

title: Doubling a dimension is not doubling both
html:
Start with 12 × 8 pixels at 4 bits per pixel.

Design A

24 × 8 pixels
4 bits per pixel

Design B

24 × 16 pixels
4 bits per pixel

How does each pixel payload compare with the original?

Show answer
A: ×2. One dimension doubles.
B: ×4. Both dimensions double.

Same fixed pixel encoding; metadata and compression excluded.
note: 先比比例再验数字：原384bits，A768bits，B1536bits。两个维度分别倍增的效果相乘。把“resolution提高一倍”这类模糊表述改为具体width/height，这样学生知道究竟哪些量保持不变。屏幕放大显示同一图片不会自动改变源图像包含的像素数据，本页比较的是重新编码后不同尺寸的位图。

title: Choose detail for a purpose
html:
Two sensors have different goals.

A: brief changes

Detect short changes in a signal that occur between current measurements.

B: small value differences

Distinguish nearby values that currently round to the same level.

Which sampling control directly addresses each limitation?

Show answer
A: consider more frequent measurements.
B: consider more value levels over the same range.

Evaluate the extra data against the user’s needs; neither change guarantees success.
note: 不要承诺高采样率一定抓住所有短事件；应当说针对时间分辨不足的改进方向。B固定测量时刻，但用更多等级区分细微值差。要求学生说明增加数据量的成本和所服务目的。范围没保持相同则更多levels不必更精细，因此再次强调same range。

title: Explain one complete digitization path
html:
A microphone system stores a sound recording.

  1. A changing sound produces a varying measurement signal.
  2. The system takes regular measurements and encodes their values.
  3. The program writes the encoded samples to storage.

Which item is the digital record? What does it leave out?

Show answer
The encoded samples. They keep selected measurements at finite precision, not every value at every instant.
note: 联系L02输入输出，但不把空气本身称为已经数字化的程序输入。物理声音经传感器形成信号，再经采样编码成为计算机可处理数据。存储文件属于程序输出，无需屏幕显示。无需画ADC电路或解释数模转换器，重点是分清信号与其数字表示。学生用“声音文件里有原来的声音”时追问它实际保存的是何种数据。

title: Changing the sampling rate
html:
A recorder doubles its sampling rate. Duration and bits per sample stay fixed.

What happens to its uncompressed sample payload?

A. It halves.

B. It stays the same.

C. It doubles.

D. It is guaranteed to reproduce the signal exactly.

Show answer
C. Twice as many samples × the same bits per sample. D confuses more detail with a guarantee of exactness.
note: 让学生先写N×b模型再选项，不靠背“higher rate larger file”。题目严格排除duration变化和每样本位数变化；实际文件总大小还可能有固定开销，因此问payload。A方向反了；B忽略样本数增加；D不是容量结论且对任意信号无精确保证。原创题不要标“past paper”。

title: Select exactly two supported statements
html:
A model uses 8 samples, each encoded with 3 bits.

Which TWO statements are supported?

A. At most 8 value codes are available per sample.

B. The sample payload contains 24 bits.

C. The original signal is recovered exactly in every case.

D. Each sample is exactly one byte.

Show answer
A and B. 2³ = 8 possible codes; 8 × 3 = 24 bits. Finite samples do not guarantee exactness; one byte is 8 bits.
note: 逐项判定再选两项。A说at most是为了允许部分代码不用，不假定每种代码都实际出现。B用样本数乘位数；C检查近似的边界；D回顾bit/byte。若学生把eight samples与eight levels混淆，可把两个8分别标“时刻数量”和“可选值数量”。

title: Keep the assumptions with the calculation
html:
Homework: about 40 minutes.

  • State the encoding or interpretation you use.
  • Keep time sampling and value levels separate.
  • Label bits, bytes, pixels and samples.
  • Use payload formulas only under the stated assumptions.

Next: what can be reduced when we compress data?
note: Q1–Q2回顾第一章；Q3–Q6选择题；Q7–Q12有模拟数字比较、样本近似、编码和像素计算。Q5恰好选两项，两项全对且无其他选项才得1分。今天只讨论数据采集与表示，下一课才系统区分压缩方式，避免现在把采样等同某种文件压缩。

title: Exit ticket: four decisions
html:
1. Which directly changes measurement times: sample rate or value levels?
  2. How many codes can 4 bits represent?
  3. A 4 × 4 bitmap uses 2 bits per pixel. Find its pixel payload.
  4. Does a finite digital recording guarantee every detail of any analog signal?
Show answer
1. Sample rate.
2. 16 codes.
3. 32 bits = 4 bytes, with overhead excluded.
4. No. Sampling and finite value precision limit the representation.
note: 独立3分钟、检查2分钟。四项各1分，第3项要求bits或bytes单位。建议3/4且第1、4题正确可继续；若只错容量或单位，下课做针对性两题；若把采样次数与值等级混淆，下一课前用实验两控制分别调节补练。此诊断标准是教师设计，不是官方AP评分。
